\begingroup\leavevmode
\pgfmathsetlengthmacro{\trFrame}{max(\linewidth,252.00pt)}% layout width
\setbox0=\hbox{\color{black}%
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\scriptsize]
% grays of make_r4_revised_figures.py, local to this picture
\definecolor{trGrid}{HTML}{CBD3D8}%    dotted grid
\definecolor{trRegion}{HTML}{7E9AAB}%  "preferable" region
\definecolor{trRegionText}{HTML}{4F6675}
\definecolor{trKey}{HTML}{52616B}%     legend keys
% The PNG shades the region with alpha 0.30 (1 - d)^0.85, d the elliptical
% distance from the lower-right corner (semi-axes 0.62 and 0.50 of the axis box);
% these stops are that profile over white at d = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9 and 1.
\pgfdeclareradialshading{trPreferable}{\pgfpoint{0bp}{0bp}}{color(0bp)=(trRegion!30.00!white); color(6.25bp)=(trRegion!23.49!white); color(12.5bp)=(trRegion!16.64!white); color(18.75bp)=(trRegion!9.23!white); color(22.5bp)=(trRegion!4.24!white); color(25bp)=(trRegion!0.00!white); color(50bp)=(white)}
\pgfmathsetlengthmacro{\trW}{\trFrame-43.14pt}% width of the axis box
\pgfmathsetlengthmacro{\trH}{0.90587*\trW}% height of the axis box
% means and SDs across partitions (row 1 clean-only, row 2 augmented)
% Word TF-IDF: K = 100 partitions
\pgfplotstableread[row sep=\\]{
  training f1 f1sd fpr fprsd\\
  clean 0.9212381 0.005080496 0.03592486 0.002396459\\
  augmented 0.9463579 0.004573606 0.05277457 0.003884049\\
}\trWord
% MiniLM: K = 100 partitions
\pgfplotstableread[row sep=\\]{

}\trMini

}\trBert

  axis x line*=bottom, axis y line*=left, axis line style={line width=0.7pt},
  tick align=outside, major tick length=3pt, every tick/.append style={line width=0.7pt, black},
  tick label style={font=\scriptsize}, label style={font=\footnotesize},

  xtick={0.8,0.82,0.84,0.86,0.88,0.9,0.92,0.94,0.96}, ytick={0,0.02,0.04,0.06,0.08,0.1,0.12,0.14,0.16},
  scaled ticks=false,
  xticklabel style={/pgf/number format/.cd, fixed, fixed zerofill, precision=2},
  yticklabel style={/pgf/number format/.cd, fixed, fixed zerofill, precision=2},
  grid=major, major grid style={line width=0.5pt, draw=trGrid, dash pattern=on 0.5pt off 0.825pt},

  ylabel={Spam hard-negative FPR at threshold 0.5},
  legend style={name=trLegend, draw=none, fill=none, font=\scriptsize, inner sep=0pt,

  legend cell align=left,
]
% "preferable" region: a guide, not data; below the grid as in the PNG
\begin{pgfonlayer}{axis background}
  \begin{scope}
    \clip (rel axis cs:0,0) rectangle (rel axis cs:1,1);
    \shade[shading=trPreferable] (rel axis cs:1,0) ellipse [x radius=0.62*\trW, y radius=0.5*\trH];

\end{pgfonlayer}
\node[anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=0pt, text=trRegionText, font=\scriptsize\itshape]
  at (rel axis cs:0.975,0.03) {preferable: higher L2 F1,\\fewer spam false alarms};

\addplot[draw=none, forget plot, error bars/.cd, x dir=both, y dir=both, x explicit, y explicit, error mark=-, error bar style={oiVermillion, line width=0.8pt, opacity=0.75}, error mark options={rotate=90, oiVermillion, line width=0.8pt, mark size=1.8pt, opacity=0.75}] table[x=f1, y=fpr, x error=f1sd, y error=fprsd] {\trBert};

\addplot[only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.8pt, mark options={draw=oiGreen, fill=white, line width=1.4pt}, skip coords between index={1}{2}, forget plot] table[x=f1, y=fpr] {\trMini};
\addplot[only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.8pt, mark options={draw=oiGreen, fill=oiGreen, line width=1.4pt}, skip coords between index={0}{1}, forget plot] table[x=f1, y=fpr] {\trMini};
\addplot[only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.8pt, mark options={draw=oiVermillion, fill=white, line width=1.4pt}, skip coords between index={1}{2}, forget plot] table[x=f1, y=fpr] {\trBert};
\addplot[only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.8pt, mark options={draw=oiVermillion, fill=oiVermillion, line width=1.4pt}, skip coords between index={0}{1}, forget plot] table[x=f1, y=fpr] {\trBert};
\node[anchor=south, align=center, inner sep=0pt, text=oiBlue, font=\scriptsize\bfseries\boldmath] at (axis cs:0.9335,0.0605) {Word TF--IDF\\$K = 100$};
\node[anchor=north, align=center, inner sep=0pt, text=oiGreen, font=\scriptsize\bfseries\boldmath] at (axis cs:0.834,0.0475) {MiniLM\\$K = 100$};
\node[anchor=south east, align=right, inner sep=0pt, text=oiVermillion, font=\scriptsize\bfseries\boldmath] at (axis cs:0.8355,0.113) {DistilBERT\\$K = 20$};
\addlegendimage{legend image code/.code={\draw[trKey, line width=1.3pt, fill=white] (5.2pt,0pt) circle[radius=2.6pt];}}
\addlegendentry{clean-only (mean)}

\addlegendentry{augmented (mean)}
